name: vision
description: Vision-capable model reads screenshots and images.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.description: Analyses an image with AI vision (OCR, description, recognition). Use this tool when the user wants to show, describe, read out or explain an image, screenshot, photo or document. Supported: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP.

path.description: Path to the image — absolute or ~-relative, e.g. '~/Desktop/screenshot.png'.

question.description: Question about the image, e.g. 'What does this invoice say?' or 'Describe this screenshot'

region.description: Optional [x1,y1,x2,y2] crop in original pixels to zoom into small text or fine detail before analysis.

tools.name: vision_click
tools.description: Uses visual screen analysis to find a UI element on the primary desktop and physically clicks it with the mouse. Use this tool when you are asked to drive GUI applications or the user's browser. (The analysis takes a moment).

target_description.description: What should be clicked? e.g. 'the red save button top right' or 'the Chrome icon in the dock'. As precise as possible.

tools.name: vision_type
tools.description: Types a string into the currently focused input field on the user's screen. Often paired with a preceding vision_click to focus a search field.

press_enter.description: Should the Enter key be pressed after typing? (default: false)

changelog: 1.2.0 - analyze_image asks the host. The path and the question stay out of the bridge row.
